what: Inference with Extreme Value Inflated Count Data
title: Inference with Extreme Value Inflated Count Data
text: evinf fits extreme-value inflated count-regression models: extreme-value zero-inflated negative binomial (EVZINB) model zero-inflation-free counterpart (EVINB), described Randahl, David, Johan Vegelius. 2024. “Inference Extremes: Accounting Extreme Values Count Regression Models.” International Studies Quarterly 68(4): sqae137. https://doi.org/10.1093/isq/sqae137 package also provides bootstrap-based inference, prediction (component probabilities, harmonic mean, quantiles), likelihood-ratio tests individual covariates, comparison plain negative-binomial ZINB models. designed work broom / generics (tidy(), glance()) modelsummary. Since version 0.10.0 EM tuning settings bundled evinf_control(), candidate range extreme-value threshold C_EV chosen data default, count formula accepts offset() term, fitted models support standard S3 methods (coef(), vcov(), confint(), AIC(), predict(), residuals(), simulate(), update(), plot()) well predict_grid(), marginal_effects() compare_fit(). See NEWS.md full list.

text: Separate formulas can given count, zero-inflation, extreme-value inflation Pareto components, e.g.
code: library(evinf) data(genevzinb2)  # Fit an EVZINB model with 100 bootstrap replicates model <- evzinb(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = genevzinb2, n_bootstraps = 100)  summary(model) tidy(model)                       # all components, one row per coefficient glance(model)                     # goodness-of-fit predict(model, type = "harmonic") # harmonic-mean prediction  lr_test(model, "x1")              # LR test for x1 across all components compare_models(model)             # against NB and ZINB evzinb(y ~ x1 + x2, formula_zi = ~ x1, formula_pareto = ~ log1p(x3),        data = genevzinb2)

title: evinf 0.10.0
text: Bootstrap replicates whose extreme-value tail collapses (smallest fitted Pareto shape evinf_control(alpha_floor = ), default 0.001) flagged  rather silently skewing summaries. carry $degenerate / $degenerate_reason; failed_bootstraps() lists (new type column, "error" / "degenerate"); glance() gains n_degenerate_bootstraps n_bootstraps now counts usable replicates; print() / summary() report count. Every bootstrap-summary function (coef() bootstrap extractor, vcov(), confint(), tidy(), summary(), predict(), marginal_effects()) excludes degenerate replicates default takes exclude_degenerate = FALSE keep . evinf_control() bundles EM tuning settings; evzinb() / evinb() gain control argument. individual tuning arguments still work deprecated favour control. candidate range C_EV now chosen data default (c.lim = NULL); printed message. c_profile() / plot_c_profile() show log-likelihood profile range; glance() gains n_above_c n_em_steps; fitted object carries $c_profile, $c_trace, $loglik_trace. offset() count-component formula supported (mu_NB = exp(x'b + offset)), e.g. y ~ x + offset(log(exposure)). Standard S3 methods: coef(), vcov() (bootstrap covariance), confint(), logLik() / AIC() / BIC(), nobs(), formula(), terms(), model.frame(), fitted(), residuals() (response randomized quantile), simulate(), update(). revzinb_fit() / revinb_fit() superseded simulate(). add_bootstraps() extends existing fit replicates; failed_bootstraps() returns error messages replicates failed. Bootstrap seeds recorded $boot_seeds. Progress reporting bootstrap loops (lr_test(bootstrap = TRUE) compare_models()) progressr (shown verbose = TRUE progressr handler set), replacing old cat() messages. classify_states() returns prior posterior state classification per observation; state_table() cross-tabulates . predict_grid() builds one-variable prediction grid (covariates held mean/median modal level, pinned via ) evaluates model long form, optionally bootstrap confidence intervals. plot() methods fitted models: type = "states" (prior state probabilities covariate), "prediction" (harmonic-mean prediction bootstrap ribbon quantile lines), "coefficients" (bootstrap coefficient densities), "ppc" (observed-vs-expected binned frequencies) "ppc_quantiles" (observed vs. simulated tail quantiles 5-95% band). compare_fit() summarises paired bootstrap differences (compared - evinf) AIC, BIC --bag RMSE / RMSLE evzinbcomp object, proportion bootstraps favouring extreme-value model; plot(), tidy() glance() methods evzinbcomp oob_evaluation() method tabulates --bag error per model. marginal_effects() computes average marginal effects (central difference numeric covariates, level-vs-reference contrasts factors) harmonic mean, state probabilities predicted quantile, bootstrap confidence intervals. type = "quantile", whose bootstrap distribution heavy-tailed, reported std.error robust scale percentile interval rather raw standard deviation. marginaleffects compatibility: evzinb / evinb models register marginaleffects load, marginaleffects::avg_slopes() friends work bootstrap delta-method standard errors. gof_map_evinf() returns modelsummary goodness--fit map (extra argument append rows); bundled gm_evzinb data object now generated gains obs_above_c_ev row. evzinb() / evinb() accept block bare column name (block = id) well string. print(summary(model)) reports number observations C_EV notes log-likelihood recomputed.

title: evinf 0.10.0
text: predict(type = "quantile") marginal_effects(type = "quantile") parametrised negative-binomial part mixture Alpha.NB every part package (likelihood, residuals(type = "quantile"), simulate()) uses size = 1 / Alpha.NB. Predicted quantiles now use correct dispersion; effect small evzinb (Alpha.NB near 1) can large -dispersed evinb fit. marginal_effects(type = "quantile") longer returns zeros. mixture quantile rounded integer predict(), central finite difference step function zero almost everywhere; marginal- effects path now differentiates continuous (unrounded) quantile. quantiles_from_*() gain round argument (TRUE default; predict(type = "quantile") unchanged). marginal_effects(method = "difference") now implemented numeric covariates (average change delta-unit increase, default 1 unit); previously accepted ignored. type = "quantile" defaults method = "difference". marginal_effects(type = "quantile") caps rows averages n_max (new argument, default 500; automatic nrow * n_bootstraps = 2e5, whenever set explicitly; n_max = Inf disables ), message. per-observation mixture-quantile solve made prohibitively slow data size hks. update() longer embeds whole data frame refitted model’s stored call. evzinb() / evinb() keep data expression user passed; update() re-evaluates , falling back embedded copy (bound symbol) expression can longer resolved. model$call str(model) stay small large data. evzinb() / evinb() resolve bare block name matching column data trying evaluate , unrelated object name calling environment longer shadows column. add_bootstraps() errors boot_seed already used model (%dorng% stream fully determined seed, silently duplicate existing draws shrink bootstrap SEs). evzinb() / evinb() now always record seed actually used (drawing one boot_seed = NULL), object$boot_seeds complete. mixture_p() (mixture CDF behind residuals(type = "quantile")) now uses discretised Pareto CDF matches pmf likelihood uses (1 - (C/(y+1))^y >= C), rather continuous 1 - (C/y)^. Randomized quantile residuals shift small amount extreme-value tail (genevzinb2, 12 100 residuals move, max change 0.015). evinb() longer runs EVZINB EM step (updates zero-inflation block) warm-phase – copy-paste artefact pre-0.10.0 code. zero-inflation intercept now held fixed throughout, model intends. Estimates unchanged machine precision tested data (fixed intercept starts far enough zero spurious update numerically inert). Block-bootstrap: block variable now included single na.omit() step, model whose block column missing values model variables longer mis-indexes resamples (previously error silently sample wrong rows). lr_test() refits restricted models full model’s control settings (candidate range C, tolerances, pdf.pl.type, …) warm- started full-model estimates. Previously used package defaults, model fitted non-default c.lim compared restricted fit searched different candidate set C_EV (LR statistic even come negative). internal check reported log-likelihood equals log-likelihood returned parameters longer warns inside every bootstrap; recomputes silently, records object$loglik_recomputed, (full-sample fit, verbose = TRUE) emits single message. user-registered parallel backend (doParallel, doFuture, …) left untouched function called multicore = FALSE. non-finite value produced -formula transformation (e.g. log(x) x <= 0) now raises informative error naming column instead misbehaving C++ code. User-supplied init.Beta.NB used (regression-test hardened). evinb parameter count predict.*boot(pred = "original") indexing fixes (carried 0.9.4 audit follow-ups). predict() zinb slot compare_models() result type = "counts" (type = "", type = "counts", confint = TRUE) longer errors “$ operator invalid atomic vectors”.

title: evinf 0.10.0
text: parallel backend now future / furrr instead foreach / doParallel / doRNG (longer imported). Set plan session — future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 8) — every bootstrap loop (evzinb(), evinb(), add_bootstraps(), lr_test(bootstrap = TRUE), compare_models(), predict(), marginal_effects()) uses . multicore argument now defaults NULL (respect current plan); multicore = TRUE still works shortcut sets temporary multisession plan one call restores previous plan exit, multicore = FALSE still forces sequential execution. See new “Parallel processing” section ?evzinb. RNG now derived furrr’s per-element L’Ecuyer streams, bootstrap resamples drawn given boot_seed differ earlier versions (resampling distribution unchanged, results longer depend number workers). Pin results need reproduce. future furrr new hard dependencies; foreach, doParallel, doRNG mistr dropped. extreme-value component mixture now single, package-wide discretised Pareto (R/dist_pareto.R): pmf  integer . Previously predict(type = "quantile") / quantiles_from_*() / marginal_effects(type = "quantile") built mixture mistr inverted . new path bisects mixture CDF used residuals(type = "quantile") likelihood, also corrects negative-binomial dispersion quantiles used (parametrised NB Alpha.NB rather canonical size = 1 / Alpha.NB). evzinb fit, Alpha.NB near 1, predicted quantiles move count two; evinb fit strongly -dispersed count component old quantiles large factor. simulate() / revzinb_fit() / revinb_fit() draw extreme-value part floor(C * U^(-1/alpha)) (round(...)), simulated extreme-value counts ~0.5 lower average never C. minimum R version now 4.1.0. NAMESPACE uses delayed S3 method registration insight / marginaleffects, needs R >= 3.6.0; 4.1 common floor packages using pattern. approximate bootstrap runtime estimate printed verbose = TRUE (always printed 0.9.4; note missing 0.9.4 changelog). predict(type = "") every confint = TRUE output now lead canonical state-probability columns (pr_zero, pr_count, pr_evi), keeping deprecated pr_zc / pr_pareto trailing duplicates — matching predict(type = "states") already . Default fits change slightly: c.lim = NULL candidate set C_EV data-driven init.C defaults median set, estimates default 0.9.x call bit-identical default 0.10.0 call. Pin evinf_control(c.lim = ..., init.C = ...) reproduce older fit. gm_evzinb gains row (obs_above_c_ev) parameter row now formatted 0 decimals; regenerate cached copy gof_map_evinf(). hks column brv_AllLag renamed brv_AllLag_log (log scale, like _log columns). alias — code referring old name get immediate “object found” / “column found” error. predict() nb / zinb slot compare_models() result longer accepts type = "evinf" (plain NB / ZINB extreme-value state); match.arg() now rejects . three internal marginal.effect.* helpers (never exported, superseded marginal_effects()) removed.

title: evinf 0.9.4
text: Likelihood-ratio statistic. lr_test() now reports standard 2 * (logLik_full - logLik_restricted) statistic (uses bootstrap reference distribution). Statistics reported earlier versions half correct value; p-values change accordingly qualitative conclusions Randahl & Vegelius (2024) unaffected. Degrees freedom now number design-matrix columns removed across components (removing four-level factor contributes three degrees freedom). Component vocabulary. Model components now named "count", "zero", "evi" "pareto" everywhere (tidy(), coefficient_extractor(), summary()). old names "nb", "zi" "evinf" still work emit deprecation warning. predict(type = ) additionally accepts "zero" "zi" "evi" "evinf". tidy() default now component = "" ("zi"), bare tidy(model) / modelsummary(model) shows every component. y.level values tidy(component = "") zero, evi, count, pareto. Column renames (old names kept duplicates release ): predict(type = "states") columns pr_zero / pr_count / pr_evi; model$fitted$prob_pareto / posterior_pareto become prob_evi / posterior_evi; props / resp matrices labelled zero / count / evi. compare_models() returns fitted model $model; $evzinb remains alias. now also accepts evinb objects (zinb_comparison forced FALSE). generics moved Depends Imports; tidy() glance() re-exported, library(broom) / library(generics) longer required. Dependencies MLmetrics, stringr stringi removed. Minimum R version raised 3.5 (data files re-serialised).

title: evinf 0.9.4
text: compare_models() fitted bootstrapped ZINB zero-inflation formula model parts; now uses full count | zero formula, matching full-sample fit. summary() tidy() longer error models fitted bootstrap = FALSE; return point estimates message. summary(p_value = "") now returns bootstrap approximate p-values (approximate branch previously unreachable). lr_test() works evinb objects (passed wrong data object ). Design matrices built model.matrix() rather model.frame()[, -1], factor character covariates, interactions, poly() / splines -formula transformations log(x) now work labelled correctly. na.omit() applied union component variables, keeping components row-consistent. User-supplied init.Beta.NB longer silently discarded NB EVI formulas differ length. evinb() bootstraps returned object now named. negative-probability guard predictor actually fires now. predict.nbboot() / predict.zinbboot() registered S3 methods. summary() gains print method; print.evzinb() / print.evinb() show correct component formulas plus C_EV count observations C_EV. glance() methods return unrounded values gain converged, n_bootstraps n_failed_bootstraps columns; gm_evzinb updated match. Parallel backends always unregistered exit, “executing sequentially” / “Joining ” messages emitted. run_evinb()’s default c.lim matches evinb(); pdf.pl.type validated. fitting routines check reported log-likelihood log-likelihood returned parameters recompute logLik / AIC / BIC (warning) . tidy(confint = ) implemented (percentile approximate intervals). revzinb_fit() / revinb_fit() draw Pareto values single vectorised call. evinb objects longer count (fixed) zero-inflation coefficients free parameters: glance()$npar, AIC, BIC approximate-test degrees freedom corrected accordingly. predict() nbboot / zinbboot objects pred = "original" used stray loop index errored; now predicts full-sample model.
